name: One District One Product (ODOP) Awards
benefit: Under this scheme, each awardee will receive a commemorative trophy and certificate recognizing excellence in their respective award category. The award will reflect the recipient’s unique contribution to promoting One District One Product (ODOP) and will be customized according to the specific category.
_eligibility_text: 1. All States/ UTs, Districts, Indian Missions Abroad, E-Commerce platforms, and Central Ministries/departments are eligible for the award. 1. The applications will be considered valid for the progress achieved in the promotion of the identified product from the respective district identified under DPIIT’s ODOP initiative only. The [list of products ](https://static.investindia.gov.in/s3fs-public/2025-07/v31_odop_product_list_20250702.pdf)identified under the initiative can be accessed.
